    Socles of finite-length modules #

    This file supplies the intrinsic dual of the simple-top interface used in the Pogorzały--Skowroński induction. The socle is the sum of all simple submodules. In an Artinian module it meets every nonzero submodule, so a simple socle forces indecomposability.
